description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gotabayapura, Thissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830078 and other title settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
